programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt treats a springer spaniel with a footballer's knee injury, and unblocks the nostrils of an African Grey parrot called Rosie and fights to save the life of a sparrowhawk which has been hit by a car.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Baxter is a Shih-Tzu that was discovered abandoned in an empty house on the outskirts of Manchester; thin and with extremely matted fur. Inspector Lyndsey Taylor comes to the rescue, but until all that fur is removed, nobody knows what lies beneath.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: We've got monkey criminals, magic and mirrors, cheeky monkeys, monkey pals, banana loving primates, baby monkeys, monkeys vs cameras, monkeys out on the town, and monkeys acting like us humans.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The extremly cute capybara loves massage, black-footed penguins from Africa show off their superb diving abilities, be careful cause mini pigs aren't mini in size at all, subverting your imagination towards them, and uncovering ecology of the incredible gentle giant giraffe. "Cute Pet Guide" invites you to a trip to the zoo full of surprises!

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: To escape war, the Qiang people settled down by the water at the foot of the Yulong Mountains. After centuries of development and integration a new generation and ethnic group were formed- The Naxi. Leading a peaceful life; the Naxi’s rare and enchanting culture has a strict belief in living harmoniously with nature. The Old Town of Lijiang, is a relaxed, graceful and tranquil setting. Full of nature’s elegance, where the Naxi people have made a home for themselves, where they can practice their unique form of faith and enjoy the prosperity of their geographical position. Join us, as Discover China visits Old Town Lijiang.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: A startling scientific discovery has changed the face of evolutionary science. A single tooth shook the scientific community. The secrets the skulls of ancient ape-men, found in a Beijing suburb potentially held the key to the missing link in Human evolution. Dozens of experts formed an international team in an attempt to uncover the tracks of this specimen, and find out more about its habits. On the eve of war, these skulls suddenly disappeared off the face of the earth, leaving no trace. As the history unfolds, scientists debated the origin of the Peking ape-man, as the world wonders where his remains might be.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: In the Vietnam War the USAF discovered that 90% of their casualties occurred during pilots first 10 missions. So a specialized training exercise was developed to provide pilots with the same combat missions they could expect in their first 10 missions. The results are incredible.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Continuing his quest for belief, host Tevya get's a fresh look at the history and traditions of the Hasidic Jews (a little different to the Judaism he was used to). Rabbi Kaplan and some new friends offer insight into the most important passage in a Jewish boy's life, the Bar Mitzvah, celebrate Purim and have dinner with the Rabbi's family. Can Rabbi Kaplan reveal the answer to one of the burning questions - why can't Jews eat bacon?

programme.title: Kabul, Just Before Darkness
programme.desc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years. Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away. It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism.

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

programme.title: Silent Forests
programme.desc: More than half of the Central-African forest elephant population has been decimated by poachers in the last decade. Following one of Cameroon’s first female eco-guards, a grassroots law enforcement group, a Congolese biologist, a reformed poacher and a Czech activist, this intimate portrait gains remarkable access to an under-reported region, the Congo Basin, to understand the global poaching and…

programme.desc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years. Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away. It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism.

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

programme.title: Silent Forests
programme.desc: More than half of the Central-African forest elephant population has been decimated by poachers in the last decade. Following one of Cameroon’s first female eco-guards, a grassroots law enforcement group, a Congolese biologist, a reformed poacher and a Czech activist, this intimate portrait gains remarkable access to an under-reported region, the Congo Basin, to understand the global poaching and…

programme.title: One Bride, Seven Cows or a Box of Heroin
programme.desc: Girls sold for school fees, for heroin. From Vietnam’s Mei to Afghanistan’s Mujgan, their stories.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Qing turmoil sparked plots to empty Imperial City palaces. Uncover Pu Yi’s secret deals as royal art & priceless calligraphy flowed out under watchful eyes.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Hand-to-hand combat, it is every soldiers greatest fear. At the Army Combatives School in Fort Benning, Georgia, they teach soldiers how to fight to survive. Teach them skills that are beyond UFC…skills that kill!

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Trading in his city clothes and cell phone for a black hat and plain shirt, host Tevya goes off the grid into a world where technology is taboo and life is humble. Mennonites live without modern conveniences, drive horse and buggies and worship in their own devout yet simple ways. Can city-boy Tevya survive a cattle auction, farming by hand and a quilting circle?

They navigate identity, family, and politics amid anti-Asian hate, BLM, and Trump era, aiming to make history.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Follow Confucius, a key cultural icon. Born to a declining noble family, no one foresaw he'd become China’s most revered figure.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Today nuclear subs dominate the seas…yet their biggest threat is a diesel submarine. The modern diesel submarine is capable of a wide range of capabilities and it is known for its incredible stealth. We learn more about why they are so lethal in the dark depths of the Norwegian Fiords while on a NATO exercise inside a modern diesel submarine.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: It is the fastest growing Christian church on earth and here The Holy Spirit truly flows. Host Tevya joins the boisterous celebration of worship at a Pentecostal Revival church where speaking in tongues, writhing on the floor and spiritual healing are all part of the faith experience. He travels to Bible camp to learn how young Pentecostals really feel the spirit, get baptized and how they pray for Tevya's soul.

programme.title: Turning a Blind Eye
programme.desc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland. Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own. The crime shocked the whole country. What had happened between this couple, living a seemingly ordinary life with their three children? Each year, nearly 90,000 women are killed by their partner or ex-partner throughout the world. Could more have been done to save Mélanie?

programme.title: A Gentleman Thief
programme.desc: Vincenzo Pipino is a thief, he was convicted and has done over 25 years in prison both in Italy and in the rest of Europe and has expiated his faults. The documentary tells the story of this last gentleman thief.

programme.title: The Silent Scream
programme.desc: Since thirty years the data on the glaciers melting are truly alarming .There are men who have dedicated most of their lives to glaciers, photographing, measuring and monitoring them. This documentary collects their testimonies, bringing more awareness about the current state of glaciers and our mountains

programme.title: Messages from the End of the World
programme.desc: The documentary describes the dramatic consequences of the climate change in the Arctic zone. Thanks to the Swiss Arctic Project five young people have been navigating for three weeks through hostile and beautiful landscapes up to the North. They have documented the signs of global warming and raise the new generation’s awareness through social networks.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Silent, covert, deadly; they are every battle commander’s secret weapon. Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield. We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train; learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Dreadlocks. Reggae and Bob Marley. Tevya meets a teenager who unlocks the truth behind the beliefs of the "Rasta".

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Dogs
programme.desc: A canine-crazed world: lawn crappers, a pelican-hunted Chihuahua, cross-dressing Boris, and dubber-loving Fugly. Where dogs just want to be dogs, and owners want them to be people.

programme.title: Banzai Switzerland
programme.desc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

programme.title: The Natural History of the Chicken
programme.desc: A quirky documentary exploring chickens beyond food, through eccentric stories of headless runners, supernatural tales, and a woman who'd rather bond than eat them.

programme.title: K2 and The Invisible Footmen
programme.desc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Skull unearthed 1929: Peking Man, by Pei Wen Zhong, China.

programme.title: Amazing Dog Tales
programme.desc: A “Dream Dog Park” is erected, a Dog Chauffeur (at your doggie service), Boston’s most amazing Dog Bakery and a groomer with all the tools.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Tevya meets an Arab Christian high-school student from the West Bank and then walks in the steps of Jesus to find out why Jerusalem is considered such a sacred place to all Christians.

programme.title: True or False
programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure.

programme.title: A Russian Fairytale
programme.desc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city. In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home. Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died. For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around.

programme.title: Black and Blue
programme.desc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries. Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped. Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect. Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality.

programme.title: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
programme.desc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman. Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers. Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture. This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber.

programme.title: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
programme.desc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman. Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers. Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture. This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Skull unearthed 1929: Peking Man, by Pei Wen Zhong, China.

programme.title: Amazing Dog Tales
programme.desc: A “Dream Dog Park” is erected, a Dog Chauffeur (at your doggie service), Boston’s most amazing Dog Bakery and a groomer with all the tools.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Tevya meets an Arab Christian high-school student from the West Bank and then walks in the steps of Jesus to find out why Jerusalem is considered such a sacred place to all Christians.

programme.title: True or False
programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Air-to-air combat is one the principle war fighting skills a new pilot must learn. At a massive international air exercise we join crews from several countries as they learn the basics of air combat and what it takes to survive. programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: From turbans to ceremonial daggers (kirpans), the symbols and practices of Sikhism are revealed to host Tevya in this program. At the birthday celebration for Guru Nanak, the 15th-century founder of the faith, Tevya learns how and why Sikh’s pray, how they cook “vegetarian” for the masses, and why Sikh’s consider warriors “Saintly”. The fight for the poor is a holy calling as Tevya discovers.

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like. Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme. There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells. A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole. Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security. Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally. Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release. For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: Mariupol: The Chronicles of Hell
programme.desc: Mariupol - ruined but not conquered. The city in the east of Ukraine has survived the occupation, total destruction, and a humanitarian catastrophe. The story of Mariupol is an especially horrifying one, with accounts reported that occupiers were murdering civilians, and actively preventing them from escaping. This film is the story of the survivors, and their life in a hell on Earth. Yet it's also a testament to the power of resilience, and Ukrainian fighting spirit.

programme.title: Decadence & Downfall
programme.desc: The lavish party thrown by the Shah of Iran in 1971, which marked the break between the so-called 'king of kings' and the people of Iran he reigned over.

programme.title: The Boy From The Wild
programme.desc: "The Boy from the Wild", this Documentary is brought to you by the Author Peter Meyer. He grew up on a Game Reserve in South Africa that was created by his father, who had a dream to set up a Safari but to bring Wildlife back out of Captivity from around the World and back into the Wild. This documentary shares how it began and how Peter Meyer survived some incredible moments living in the Wild but dedicating his lessons in Life to the Wildlife and his father. It's moving, cinematically stunning and truly heartfelt telling a story that has been silent for over 35 years.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Airborne soldiers are known as force multipliers because of their unique capabilities. Dropped behind enemy lines they can secure bridges or conduct ambushes. We learn more about what it takes to be a paratrooper at two of the best airborne schools in the world.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Do real life witches ride broomsticks and cast magic spells? Host Tevya talks to plants, tries a love potion and befriends some teenage witches in the magical world of Wicca. But, when the high priestess, Greymoon, directs Tevya to take a ritualistic bath as part of a welcoming rite, our spiritual explorer finds himself a little outside his comfort zone.

programme.title: The Andean Screen
programme.desc: A Northwestern Argentinian teacher leads a mobile cinema crew to the most isolated school in the Jujuy high-altitude valleys, undergoing a 20-hour journey on foot in adverse conditions. Their arrival involves us in the high-altitude educational values, portraying the isolation in the Andean worlds and how communities engage with the earth. “The Andean Screen” is a poetic analogy between cinema and travel; a choral history spun by Silvina Velázquez, principal of the school, whose tenacity introduces a new paradigm for the women of the valleys.

programme.title: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Beetle is a design classic. Celebrated by the Nazis, and championed by Hitler, the Beetle's true origins were obscured by a web of intrigue, espionage and slander. This extraordinary doc reveals the untold story of Josef Ganz, the Jewish visionary behind one of the world's most adored cars. As relatives search for traces of Ganz's legacy, they seek to recover the genius of a man edited out of history.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The world’s longest military structure, the Great Wall of China endured millennia, surviving countless wars and invasions.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: In the field of honor there is one group that stands above the rest, combat medics. They are there to help aid the wounded soldier, even if it is under heavy fire. We travel to several medic schools and participate in their training exercises to learn what it takes to save lives and make a difference for their comrades.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: 2500 years ago Zoroastrianism was the world's most powerful religion and a major influence on the development of Islam, Judaism and Christianity. Today it is one of the smallest, practiced in only a few tiny pockets around the planet. Host Tevya attends a sacrosanct New Year's party and partakes in the sacred coming of age ceremony, Navjote, in the presence of the Zoroastrian's most revered symbol - a fire that has been burning for 3,500 years.

programme.title: Pink Black and Blue
programme.desc: Three rugby girls question their own prejudices and those of their social circles towards female and male attributes in our society. All along the film we follow their locker room talks, their sport practice as well as their compromises mixing both coquettish touches and mudded knees. Without any use of speeches or theories, these teenaged girls definitely offer us another way of being girls.

programme.title: REM
programme.desc: Over four decades, 'starchitect' and master provocateur Rem Koolhaas has shaken up the field of architecture, and redefined the role of the architect in the world. Filmmaker Tomas Koolhaas spent 3 years following his father around the globe, playing witness to Rem's extraordinary creativity, as well as exploring his works through the eyes of those who actually inhabit them. REM is a rare and unique insight into the mind of a genius.

programme.title: Back To Berlin
programme.desc: Back to Berlin is the first biker flick-meets-holocaust feature documentary. Eleven motor bikers have a mission to take the Maccabiah torch from Israel to the site of the infamous 1936 Berlin Olympics, for the first Jewish Olympic Games on German soil. They will retrace the heroic journeys of the original 1930s' Maccabiah riders and discover how they or their families survived the Holocaust.

programme.title: Mergui
programme.desc: The film concerns the Myeik Archipelago in most southern Myanmar. Myanmar, also known as Burma opened its doors to foreign visitors just a few years ago. Today these 800 Islands are among the top 10 destinations of travelers and scuba diver´s bucket lists. This documentary acts as a beautiful homage to the natural environment and its native inhabitants, the Moken.

programme.desc: 2500 years ago Zoroastrianism was the world's most powerful religion and a major influence on the development of Islam, Judaism and Christianity. Today it is one of the smallest, practiced in only a few tiny pockets around the planet. Host Tevya attends a sacrosanct New Year's party and partakes in the sacred coming of age ceremony, Navjote, in the presence of the Zoroastrian's most revered symbol - a fire that has been burning for 3,500 years.

programme.title: Pink Black and Blue
programme.desc: Three rugby girls question their own prejudices and those of their social circles towards female and male attributes in our society. All along the film we follow their locker room talks, their sport practice as well as their compromises mixing both coquettish touches and mudded knees. Without any use of speeches or theories, these teenaged girls definitely offer us another way of being girls.

programme.title: REM
programme.desc: Over four decades, 'starchitect' and master provocateur Rem Koolhaas has shaken up the field of architecture, and redefined the role of the architect in the world. Filmmaker Tomas Koolhaas spent 3 years following his father around the globe, playing witness to Rem's extraordinary creativity, as well as exploring his works through the eyes of those who actually inhabit them. REM is a rare and unique insight into the mind of a genius.

programme.title: Back To Berlin
programme.desc: Back to Berlin is the first biker flick-meets-holocaust feature documentary. Eleven motor bikers have a mission to take the Maccabiah torch from Israel to the site of the infamous 1936 Berlin Olympics, for the first Jewish Olympic Games on German soil. They will retrace the heroic journeys of the original 1930s' Maccabiah riders and discover how they or their families survived the Holocaust.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Ancient Pingyao, once threatened by development, now stands preserved. Its architecture and history remain intact. Here, the foundation of China’s financial system arose.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Every soldier, sailor and airmen has to pass one hurdle before coming a member of the military – basic training. This episode examines the physical and psychological tests and training that occur in basic training. The training that takes civilians and molds them into the warriors of the future!

programme.title: The Good Education
programme.desc: Exams are approaching, the school year finally ends for Peipei, a young aspiring artist from a high school in Henan, a poor province of China. Abandoned by her family, the scapegoat of her comrades and teachers, this “wild flower” has never adapted to the rules of the institution and is struggling to find its place.

programme.title: One Extra Year
programme.desc: 62M girls out of school. One year more of learning can change everything—from infant survival to democracy’s future.

programme.title: A Greenland Story
programme.desc: A GREENLAND STORY Set in Greenland during the Summer of 2019, this film reveals a country and people at a crossroads between tradition and modernity. With no roads connecting its coastal communities, a humble boat and its Irish crew move quietly up the West coast past vast icebergs and pods of whales. We are invited into homes and communities along the way, where people share thoughts on their rapidly changing culture. This is a celebration of Greenland's culture, a lament for a changing way of life, and a yearning for a positive future for a people facing such uncertain times.

programme.title: The Sculpture
programme.desc: Philanthropist Basil Sellers and artist Terrance Plowright come together to create an impressive, multimillion dollar public sculpture symbolic of Australia's Indigenous and migrant heritage, which Basil will gift to Australia. However, in a world where public art is both admired and scorned, what begins as a 12 month project escalates into a 10 year roller coaster ride. Both philanthropist and artist are pushed to the limit, as many obstacles threaten to derail their good intentions.

programme.title: Mata Hari: the Naked Spy
programme.desc: A 100 years ago, Mata Hari faced the firing squad as a convicted German spy. Was she a dangerous spy, whose boldness and sexuality threatened the establishment, or a victim entangled in a climat of blame and desperation as WWI dragged on?

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Combat requires that soldiers be tough, capable of strength and good cardio-vascular endurance. Combat fitness is the specialized training that is given to soldiers to help them survive. We learn why this is important and how this training is even adapted for civilians.

programme.title: Made in China
programme.desc:
The celebration of the Chinese New Year is coming and Yu Liang Yuan (21 years old) starts his journey from the industrial colony where he resides in Shenzhen to his birthplace in Henan (inland of the Asiatic giant). But these aren't any regular holidays. his year, his visit is crucial for his future and that of his family. He hopes to get engaged with an old schoolmate whom he's been dating.
What nobody could actually foresee, is that she and her family have been looking for other candidates and have decided that Yu Liang Yuan's family is not rich enough to accept their marriage proposal.
This unexpected turn of events will force him to start questioning the world around him and the need to follow a set of rules and traditions which he doesn't really share. Forcing him to face who he is and what he truly wants.

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like. Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme. There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells. A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole. Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security. Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally. Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release. For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Film idea: A world where workplace equality is already reality. Everyone treated, paid, and expected the same. The impact? Profound.

programme.title: Crimes Of The Future
programme.desc: Through conversations with an array of Norwegian writers, filmmakers, psychiatrists, artists and more, Izquierdo investigates the impact of both the film and novel on generations of Norwegian culture and artistic practice, while exploring how it could speak about what it means to be an artist today.

programme.title: An Italian Youth
programme.desc: Mathieu Volpe, film director invites us to follow Sokuro over a long period of time. Through a few key moments in the love story between Sokuro and Nassira, he offers another perspective on economic migration, which through this embodied representation takes on a more intimate quality. Regret, nostalgia and lack are the side effects of these reluctant exiles, done out of necessity rather than desire, that are too often kept in the shadows. By offering faces and bodies to a current topic, by embodying it and taking the time to explore its complexity, documentary cinema allows to deepen our reflection; Sokuro and Nassira’s contradictory yet profoundly human aspirations as well as their story is superimposed over the media narratives around the subject, enriching and humanising them.

programme.desc: Explore the worlds of hooved animals from deer and rhinos to pigs and goats. A diverse collection of some of the most interesting animals in the world.

programme.title: The Blue Realm E6
programme.desc: Sharks are BIG business in adrenaline eco-tourism. And some thrill seekers deliberately pursue close encounters with deadly sharks – without the protection of a cage. The bigger and more dangerous the shark, the better.

programme.title: Wild Ones E13
programme.desc: TV series explores different aspects of animal behavior, including hunting techniques and feeding habits, family relationships and defense mechanisms, courtship and mating rituals.

programme.title: World of the Wild E12
programme.desc: Among the earth’s most dramatic geological features, the mountains are home to a hardy band of creatures that have evolved to prosper where few others dare to tread.

programme.title: Safari Flix
programme.desc: Safari Flix is hosted by an experienced ranger/guide who provides compelling in-the-moment narration on the action as it happens. Not only will viewers marvel at the incredible wildlife sightings featured in the show, but so too will they be exposed to a wealth of information on the animals in particular and the African bush and pressing environmental matters in general.

programme.title: The Blue Realm E7
programme.desc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics. They were hunted to the brink of extinction until a moratorium on killing them was implemented in the 1960s. But after finally rebounding in numbers, whaling nations are exploring ways to re-open the hunt. In Antarctica, Japan is targeting minke, fin, and now... humpbacks.

programme.title: Twisted Tales
programme.desc: We explore the terrifying myths and harsh realities surroundingwolves. Long feared as savage killers and vilified in stories from Little Red Riding Hood to Hollywood's werevolves, wolves are also respected in many cultures for their intelligence and social bonds. Discover the true nature of these misunderstood animals, their rold in the ecosystem.

programme.desc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics. Discover the true nature of these misunderstood animals, their rold in the ecosystem.

programme.title: Animal Armory E2
programme.desc: From rams to lizards, many animals rely on direct body-to-body combat. This episode uncovers headbutts, wrestling, and full-on melees in the natural world.

programme.title: The Blue Realm E9
programme.desc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic – all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution.

programme.title: Twisted Tales
programme.desc: We delve into the world of flies, exploring ehtir annoying habits, vast numbers, and surprising benefits. From spreading diseases like malaria to playing vitalroles in nature, flies are more than just pests. Discover their fascinating behaviors, contributions to medical science, and unique adaptations that make them one of the most successful groups of insects.

programme.title: Super Senses E2
programme.desc: On this episode we travel from the desert, to the forest, Australia to Borneo and back to learn how species as diverse as Bat-eared Foxes, the Bilby, Deer, Kangaroo Rats, cicadas, Proboscis Monkeys and other creatures never miss an auditory trick.

programme.title: Survive The Wild E1
programme.desc: Which strategies do animals use in their quest to gain territory? We see how possession of territory is a great advantage in the wild.

programme.title: Animal Armory E4

programme.title: The Blue Realm E11
programme.desc: There's no doubt sharks have an image problem. And they're certainly in trouble globally. The population of some species has declined by more than 90% due to over fishing. But there's still one place in the world where sharks thrive – the Bahamas. Sharks not only prosper there, they are highly protected. It’s illegal to kill them.

programme.title: Twisted Tales
programme.desc: We dive into the world of crocodiles and alligators, exploring their fearsome reputation and the reality of their existence. These ancient predators have been both revered and reviled throughout history. Discover the myths, legends, and surprising facts about these naural-born killers, and learn how we can coexist with them in the modern world.

programme.title: Super Senses E4
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we examine how things taste, and how vital scent is from the animal perspective. But their sense of smell will also detect the scent of odorants carried through the air. In mammals, taste receptor cells are scattered over the tongue. In other creatures, they can be located in some fairly odd places. How taste and smell receptors work underwater, well, it's a whole other world.

programme.title: Twisted Tales
programme.desc: We dive into the world of crocodiles and alligators, exploring their fearsome reputation and the reality of their existence. These ancient predators have been both revered and reviled throughout history. Discover the myths, legends, and surprising facts about these naural-born killers, and learn how we can coexist with them in the modern world.

programme.title: Super Senses E4
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we examine how things taste, and how vital scent is from the animal perspective. But their sense of smell will also detect the scent of odorants carried through the air. In mammals, taste receptor cells are scattered over the tongue. In other creatures, they can be located in some fairly odd places. How taste and smell receptors work underwater, well, it's a whole other world.

programme.title: Survive The Wild E3
programme.desc: From microscopic single celled organisms to the largest animals on the planet, one goal is shared by all living things: to reproduce.

programme.title: Animal Armory E4
programme.desc: From venomous snakes to deadly fish, some animals have evolved chemical weapons to hunt or defend. This episode dives into the biology behind lethal toxins in the wild.

programme.title: The Blue Realm E12
programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or “chumming” – attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

programme.title: Shark Gordon
programme.desc: Shark Gordon's off to the Sea of Cortez to after his next quarry. Dive in and see the wonder of an underwater mountain as Gordon and his crew scour it for the elusive schools of hammerheads.

programme.title: Super Senses E5
programme.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans. This episode is all about those ‘super human’ senses – animal sensory systems that can detect magnetic fields (magneto- reception), electric fields (electroreception) and infrared radiation.

programme.title: Animal Armory E6
programme.desc: From skunks to sea cucumbers, nature is full of creatures that deploy foul smells or sticky substances to escape danger. These tactics often turn predators away instantly.

programme.title: The Blue Realm E13
programme.desc: Since the 1970's, sea lion populations have declined more than 80% along the North Pacific coast. Scientists at the University of British Columbia and the Vancouver Aquarium are working together to help save Canada’s iconic and largest pinniped – the stellar sea lion

programme.title: Shark Gordon
programme.desc: The Oceanic White Tip is one of the only sharks that makes Ian Gordon nervous. Fast, aggressive pack-hunters, these sharks wander the open ocean preying on whatever they can find.

programme.title: Super Senses E6
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation. Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe.

programme.title: Survive The Wild E5
programme.desc: A predator’s strategies must be superior to its prey’s if they are to win the right to feed and live another day in the unforgiving wild.

programme.title: Snake Master
programme.desc: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home.

programme.title: Shark Gordon

programme.title: Super Senses E7
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine how every animal has what could be called a sense of rhythm – the human animal included. To give an obvious example, there’s our internal body clock which responds to the so-called Circadian rhythm. That’s the 24 hour night and day cycle.

programme.title: Survive The Wild E6

programme.title: Snake Master
programme.desc: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home.

programme.title: Shark Gordon
programme.desc: Off the coast of a small Indonesian Island, Ian finds a population of Palagic Threshers performing strange of behaviours.

programme.title: Super Senses E8
programme.desc: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. Only the other way around. Once underwater our vision becomes blurred, with light diminished, our hearing becomes muffled and distorted, and our sense of smell is rendered useless.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 #7

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 #8

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 #13

programme.title: 精武英雄

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #1
programme.desc: 在調查一所國際寄宿學校的憤怒情緒時,圖書館員們遇到了一名自稱是梅林的男子.在時間耗盡之前,他們必須克服自身的憤怒,並找出魔力的源頭.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #2
programme.desc: 一隻獲釋的精靈在貝爾格勒各處許願造成混亂.圖書館員們必須將他重新封印回瓶子裡——但當維克蘭不小心許願讓自己與雅各·史東產生魔法綁定時,任務變得更加艱難.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #3
programme.desc: 在調查倫敦銀行家失蹤案時,圖書館員們發現了一個邪惡的彼得潘正在招募「無家可歸的孩子」.當查理被捕時,團隊變裝進入扭曲的無土之地(內華達/永無島)展開營救.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #4
programme.desc: 當康納被「香氣咒」迷住並成為烹飪比賽節目的參賽者時,圖書館員們必須透過擊敗節目主持人來打破魔咒.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #5
programme.desc: 圖書館員們發現迷人的年輕科學家麗莎約會的對象竟然是「紅岩」——一位在貝爾格勒打擊犯罪潮的超級英雄.他的超級英雄能力,甚至這場犯罪潮本身,是否為某件被濫用的魔法神器所導致?

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #6
programme.desc: 圖書館員們在回收卡斯托神廟與波魯克斯神廟手環時意外交換了身體.在尋找第二個手環時,他們發現梅林竟與其中一人交換了身軀,並光天化日之下潛伏在他們之中.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #7
programme.desc: 追查猴爪的圖書館員們被困在一座大霧瀰漫的謎題盒飯店中.為了逃脫,團隊必須面對過往的創傷,並釐清「心中所願」與「真正所需」之間的區別.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #8
programme.desc: 圖書館員們前往一家歷史悠久的度假村調查魔法地脈,度假行程卻被一個有意識的邪惡木偶打破.他們必須與一位年事已高的操偶師合作,阻止木偶毀掉度假村.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #9
programme.desc: 當團隊外出參加圖書館退修會時,查莉接到了受困鬧鬼房屋的小孩打來的玩具電話.她必須尋求元老級圖書館員雅各·斯通與卡珊卓·基利安的協助來營救孩子.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #10
programme.desc: 圖書館員必須幫助維克蘭失散多年的摯愛安雅,透過穿越時空的信件解開過去的謎團,以免她在維多利亞時代面臨的魔法事件波及並影響未來.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #11
programme.desc: 梅林發出的求救信號引領圖書館員來到一個所有人都陷入沉睡的小鎮.在尋找施展該咒語的神器時,團隊必須面對他們化為現實的最深層夢魘.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #12
programme.desc: 隨著渴望權力的梅林重返卡美洛,並決心改寫過去與未來,圖書館員迎來了史上最致命的任務.現在,團隊必須阻止這位強大的巫師,防止時間徹底崩塌——否則只能奮戰至死.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #1
programme.desc: 在調查一所國際寄宿學校的憤怒情緒時,圖書館員們遇到了一名自稱是梅林的男子.在時間耗盡之前,他們必須克服自身的憤怒,並找出魔力的源頭.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #2
programme.desc: 一隻獲釋的精靈在貝爾格勒各處許願造成混亂.圖書館員們必須將他重新封印回瓶子裡——但當維克蘭不小心許願讓自己與雅各·史東產生魔法綁定時,任務變得更加艱難.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #3
programme.desc: 在調查倫敦銀行家失蹤案時,圖書館員們發現了一個邪惡的彼得潘正在招募「無家可歸的孩子」.當查理被捕時,團隊變裝進入扭曲的無土之地(內華達/永無島)展開營救.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #3
programme.desc: 在調查倫敦銀行家失蹤案時,圖書館員們發現了一個邪惡的彼得潘正在招募「無家可歸的孩子」.當查理被捕時,團隊變裝進入扭曲的無土之地(內華達/永無島)展開營救.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #4
programme.desc: 當康納被「香氣咒」迷住並成為烹飪比賽節目的參賽者時,圖書館員們必須透過擊敗節目主持人來打破魔咒.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #5
programme.desc: 圖書館員們發現迷人的年輕科學家麗莎約會的對象竟然是「紅岩」——一位在貝爾格勒打擊犯罪潮的超級英雄.他的超級英雄能力,甚至這場犯罪潮本身,是否為某件被濫用的魔法神器所導致?

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #6
programme.desc: 圖書館員們在回收卡斯托神廟與波魯克斯神廟手環時意外交換了身體.在尋找第二個手環時,他們發現梅林竟與其中一人交換了身軀,並光天化日之下潛伏在他們之中.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #7
programme.desc: 追查猴爪的圖書館員們被困在一座大霧瀰漫的謎題盒飯店中.為了逃脫,團隊必須面對過往的創傷,並釐清「心中所願」與「真正所需」之間的區別.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #8
programme.desc: 圖書館員們前往一家歷史悠久的度假村調查魔法地脈,度假行程卻被一個有意識的邪惡木偶打破.他們必須與一位年事已高的操偶師合作,阻止木偶毀掉度假村.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #9
programme.desc: 當團隊外出參加圖書館退修會時,查莉接到了受困鬧鬼房屋的小孩打來的玩具電話.她必須尋求元老級圖書館員雅各·斯通與卡珊卓·基利安的協助來營救孩子.

programme.title: 探險奇兵:冒險新章 2 #10
programme.desc: 圖書館員必須幫助維克蘭失散多年的摯愛安雅,透過穿越時空的信件解開過去的謎團,以免她在維多利亞時代面臨的魔法事件波及並影響未來.

programme.title: 回到未來 III
programme.desc: 在回到未來 III中,馬蒂穿越回1885年,從亡命之徒手中救了博士.這部影片充滿了笑話,動作和感人肺腑的劇情,是這部備受喜愛的三部曲史詩般的西部大結局.

programme.title: 撲克臉 2 #11
programme.desc: 查理放棄在一場盛大婚禮上擔任侍應生,並發誓要為一位被誣陷的朋友洗刷汙名.

programme.title: 撲克臉 2 #12
programme.desc: 查理在為時已晚前急忙警告被臭名昭彰殺手盯上的目標,過程中讓她對所相信的一切產生懷疑.

programme.title: 末日光明 2 #4
programme.desc: 瑪格拉做出改變一生的決定時,可風和阿滔抵達賓沙.霸巴,芭黎絲和哈尼娃遇到一位值得信賴的朋友.

programme.title: 秘夜組織 #3
programme.desc: 蓋伊對塔拉馬斯卡的信任產生了懷疑.海倫向蓋伊講述了「七五二」的故事.

programme.title: 秘夜組織 #4
programme.desc: 賈斯柏指派蓋伊去執行一項任務:潛入當地一個吸血鬼集會所在的酒店,尋找「七五二」.

programme.title: 秘夜組織 #3
programme.desc: 蓋伊對塔拉馬斯卡的信任產生了懷疑.海倫向蓋伊講述了「七五二」的故事.

programme.title: 秘夜組織 #4

programme.title: 神之塔2 #22
programme.desc: 坤等人得知維奧萊身處險境,便前往召喚站營救他.與此同時,貝塔從FUG派來的賭徒那裡得到了「普通人」梅迪納作為隊友.貝塔允許梅迪納進入自己的身體,成為其宿主,這使他成為了一個真正的競爭對手,並開始著手消滅維奧萊的所有朋友!

programme.title: 神之塔2 #23
programme.desc: 維奧萊終於獲得了恩琉的「荊棘」.一直與維奧萊一同試圖奪取荊棘的雷弗萊霍,即使這意味著要捲入整個工坊之戰,也拼命阻止維奧萊逃跑.他們試圖透過從商店的召喚站召喚出目前作為道具的維奧萊來智取雷弗萊霍,但是...!

programme.title: 虛空魔境2 #12
programme.desc: 小鎮正為即將到來的授職儀式熱鬧非凡,奧科霍悄悄離開,避免被看見.布朗戈爾勳爵對她的舉動起了疑心,並向她發動攻擊.梅莉阻止了他,卻被奧科霍的舉動震驚了!

programme.title: 虛空魔境2 #13
programme.desc: 德拉古諾夫和莉澤洛特會見了商賈男爵杜桑,杜桑提議結盟,此舉或許能幫助宗教裁判所,並最終瓦解幻想王國.與此同時,奧科霍正在調查究竟是誰利用她的詛咒讓幽靈復仇女神現身.

programme.title: 虛空魔境2 #14
programme.desc: 宗教裁判所的入侵開始了.布狄卡進行了頑強的抵抗,但她的騎士們無法突破宗教裁判所新機器產生的幻想真空.

programme.title: 醉後末日
programme.desc: 在 醉後末日中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰.導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷,幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗.

programme.title: 美國殺人魔
programme.desc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街,於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人.隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈.這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說.

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受..

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地..

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠..

programme.title: 吳宣倫博士-挪亞的日子逼近 主必快來專題講座 生命是什麼
programme.desc: 科學家研究人類生殖,過程中有驚人發現,當人類的卵子受精的那一瞬間,卵子會爆發 超過100億個鋅離快速產生一道「細胞閃光」到底何謂生命?吳宣倫博士為大家展開生命的奧秘。

programme.title: 創世電視復興祭壇
programme.desc: 與影音使團創世電視成為一家人,一起在「創世電視復興祭壇」,以禱告和敬拜守望香港。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:彭家業博士-從利未記看上帝的禁誡
programme.desc: 當舊約的禁誡被現代潮流所衝擊、淹沒時,利未記的誡命對今日的信徒有什麼意義?現時於恩福聖經學院任教,畢業於達拉斯神學院神學碩士及哲學博士的彭家業博士,主修舊約原文釋經,對聖經希伯來文有濃厚興趣,為什麼他那麼堅持今時今日的信徒仍不可食血?從新舊約經文的對照,他又如何領略到利未記禁誡背後的亮光?

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 創世記 -呂沛淵牧師
programme.desc: 呂沛淵牧師是美國西敏神學院神學博士。曾任洛杉磯台福神學院系統神學及教會歷史專任教授。現任美國加州矽穀一華人教會牧師與神學院教授。邁向新一年, 呂牧師以《創世記》, 探討上帝創造世界與你今天的關係, 為一年之始作好準備。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:聖靈降臨,所為何事? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師-末了的話 專題的研究
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《 專題的研究》。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受..

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地..

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠..

programme.title: 吳宣倫博士-挪亞的日子逼近 主必快來專題講座 生命是什麼
programme.desc: 科學家研究人類生殖,過程中有驚人發現,當人類的卵子受精的那一瞬間,卵子會爆發 超過100億個鋅離快速產生一道「細胞閃光」到底何謂生命?吳宣倫博士為大家展開生命的奧秘。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯..

programme.desc: 節目按不同主題,包括..職場、家庭、戀愛、情緒、信仰生命,邀請七位牧者從《聖經》經文結合生活例子與大家一同靈修,建立一個不離地的信徒生命。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師-末了的話 專題的研究
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《 專題的研究》。

programme.title: 劉三論今-風風雨雨牽手情
programme.desc: 聖經上說:「人的怒氣,並不成就神的義」,你怎麼靠著神,在處理夫妻之間的矛盾中經歷得勝?創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

programme.title: 權能時間
programme.desc: 每星期播放來自美國洛杉磯「牧人園林教會」的崇拜、啟迪心靈的詩歌、感動人心的個人見證,蕭偉柏牧師傳講神的信、望、愛的信息,鼓勵信徒活出神的教導。

programme.title: 主日講壇-天行聖經教會
programme.desc: 天行聖經教會 講題: 以信為始 以信為終 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 王一平牧師-一言道破
programme.desc: 王一平牧師全新講道系列..一言道破,以精闢的教導,讓你重新認識敬拜、恩典、事奉、平安的涵意,讓聖靈重新提醒我們,怎樣做一個真基督徒。

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 《聖經》實戰攻略

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受..

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地..

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠..

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會
programme.desc: 由「愛基金」主辦、「創世電視」協辦的「一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會」,聯合不同教會的力量,加上演藝人的見證,將福音帶給香港市民。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:彭家業博士-從利未記看上帝的禁誡
programme.desc: 當舊約的禁誡被現代潮流所衝擊、淹沒時,利未記的誡命對今日的信徒有什麼意義?現時於恩福聖經學院任教,畢業於達拉斯神學院神學碩士及哲學博士的彭家業博士,主修舊約原文釋經,對聖經希伯來文有濃厚興趣,為什麼他那麼堅持今時今日的信徒仍不可食血?從新舊約經文的對照,他又如何領略到利未記禁誡背後的亮光?

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 創世記 -呂沛淵牧師
programme.desc: 呂沛淵牧師是美國西敏神學院神學博士。曾任洛杉磯台福神學院系統神學及教會歷史專任教授。現任美國加州矽穀一華人教會牧師與神學院教授。邁向新一年, 呂牧師以《創世記》, 探討上帝創造世界與你今天的關係, 為一年之始作好準備。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.desc: 巴哈, 莫劄特, 貝多芬, 蕭邦 - 四位誇越時代的鋼琴大師,在他們的生命樂章裏面,上帝的音符不斷跳動,並且影響後世無數音樂家。國際知名鋼琴家Sandra Wright Shen,曾獲得多個國際鋼琴大賽的冠軍,她將會為我們分享四位鋼琴大師的信仰故事。

programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大..

programme.title: 生活圈
programme.desc: 《生活圈》欄目全方位展現新時期中國人民的「新健康、新消費、新科技、新文化、新時尚」,以社會主義核心價值觀為引領,通過甄別媒體環境中與日常生活相關的各類資訊,引導觀眾掌握生活技巧、領悟生活智慧,宣導健康的生活方式和積極的生活態度。

programme.title: 今日説法
programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持「點滴記錄中國法治進程」的理念,以「重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓」為宗旨,採用「以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評」的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽「中國人的法制午餐」。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

programme.desc: 《第一動畫樂園》推介國產優秀動畫,是一檔適合親子互動、家庭聯歡的兒童節目,旨在傳播歡樂與純真。

方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 航向未來[粵]
高朋滿座#236[粵]
programme.desc: 義揭發情的「新男友」是德安，上前興師問罪。情道出安經已與父親反目，義不相信。義拉情回家，朋當眾宣布獲外國電視台聘請，當烹飪節目主持。言罷更向眾人表示將高家「話事人」的責任交予義，令義不敢說出情的事來。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#7[粵/普][PG]
programme.desc: 小石帶關七去找鶴發，怎料關七把鶴發的妻兒殺光，小石勸阻不果，懊悔不已。關七把想救人的小石綁住，夢枕和愁飛知道關七不好對付，便出計策讓雷損協助救人。關七在小石身上綁上炸藥並把他關在棺材裡，拖到宗書府中…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作[粵]
阿媽教落食平D[粵]
programme.desc: 六號口中的「扮嘢大菜」「紅菜頭漢堡芝士意式燴飯」，由珍珠米、非奶製芝士、紅菜頭漢堡造成，吃過後只有讚沒投訴！肥媽煮出花時間及心機的工夫菜「威靈頓牛柳」，隨時慳上過千元！她還用燕窩及醃好的雞柳，煮出與魚翅羹相似的「燕窩雞蓉羹」，響應環保。煮芥蘭前先用刀切幾下，便可做出「展翅」效果，為家人送上驚喜！六號參考網上食譜，與肥媽同做「牛油果朱古力撻」，終有機會獲得稱讚，卻為何同時換來孤獨感？

programme.title: 航向未來[粵]
programme.desc: 運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》[粵]
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市[粵] 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘[粵]
programme.desc: 牙周病為何無法根治？牙醫指此症因清潔不當讓牙菌膜積聚所致，如嚴重會令牙肉與牙骨流失，並無法自然回復狀態。牙醫強調，牙周病或會影響身體其他地方的血管、增加認知障礙風險等。除了治療資訊，牙醫亦細說相關徵兆及預防方法。掌中木偶是非遺項目之一，有學校將它與中國歷史融合並向學生推廣。副校長概述木偶的製作過程，同來的學生分享學習過程苦與樂，還即席示範簡單的木偶動作。「睇餸食飯」，Annie奉上「話梅花雕蝦」。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房[粵]
programme.desc: 徐榮與曦雯在「五分鐘速煮」，分別帶來薑蔥魚雲、芝士煙肉燒生蠔，呈現中、西滋味。徐榮的家常魚菜式獲不俗評價，唯獨下調味料時有小失誤；曦雯的出品卻令幟哥不敢品嚐？詠儀、偉灝各自奉上的「上湯龍蝦伊麵」與「西班牙紅蝦燴象拔蚌北海道海膽」皆主打鮮味。偉灝炒蝦殼期間香氣四溢，引得幟哥、「顧老闆」上前觀看。詠儀煮伊麵時獲幟哥指點可善用龍蝦湯，隨即「聽話」重做。這趟「廚師主理」強強對壘，會為比賽形勢帶來甚麼變化？

programme.title: 大帥哥#12[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 狄奇以軍法處罰沅婉三女，處罰對象令她們放棄隨軍。大軍出發後，三女遇到不祥預兆。狄奇、馬炭各自領軍突襲祿豐鎮，遇到伏擊。落蘆認定馬炭是少爺，堅持陪伴而受重傷。馬炭想起落蘆說過的軍事常識，成功製造爆炸；羅義中彈受傷，還看見三女來到，狄奇決定兵行險着……狄奇謊稱落蘆已死，引冬來說出真話。羅義緊張尋找丟失的軍帽，艾妞拾得軍帽，發現……馬炭建議狄奇趁機擴大版圖，狄奇訴說想法。英俊發帖邀請狄奇進餐……

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機[粵]
櫻桃小丸子[粵/日]
programme.desc: 媽媽與豬太郎媽媽一起上香頌班，最後更有一場發佈會，小丸子於是督促媽媽練習與減肥。小渚是住在鄉下的老鼠，她喜歡的花輪卻住在城市，花輪邀請她、小丸子和野口到家中作客，讓三鼠大開眼界。

programme.title: Hands Up[粵]
programme.desc: AI生成功能強大，但關鍵在於給予精準指令。這回「AI小學堂」就挑戰讓AI設計苦瓜餐單，指導老師建議先為AI設定合適角色，例如是熟悉香港人口味的廚師；皓誼姐姐更考驗AI構思苦瓜甜品食譜，會有甚麼新奇推介？讀出小朋友投稿分享「最艱苦的經歷」，幾位主持姐姐亦勾起不少類近回憶。Tiffany姐姐兒時參加訓練營雖然過程艱辛，但因此和夥伴建立深厚友誼；皓誼姐姐青少年時曾出埠參加泳賽，獨自遠行讓她倍感思念家人。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主[粵/日]
programme.desc: 阿玲公主的管家宣佈，偶像公主競賽即將舉行！這是選出世界第一偶像公主的賽事，目的是要令公主怦然心動、閃閃發亮。為取得第一次競賽的參賽權，美月和陽葵找上朱莉亞與詠瑠，請教寶石人氣螢光幻彩變身的秘訣。

programme.title: 財經新聞[粵]
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作[粵]
programme.desc: 鴨脷洲一個海景單位，由兩房改作四房，業主希望融入木材及雲石等物料，設計效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵]
有理說得清[粵] 及 航向未來[粵]
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 有市民在商場如廁後竟因門鎖失靈被困逾一小時，其間亦有其他長者受困，事主質疑商場設施日久失修。事主被遊說投資沉香樹，初嘗甜頭後加碼至逾十萬元，怎料僅收數月利息便遭拖款。另一投資者聯同攝製隊上門追查，發現該公司疑似仍在運作，更有長者對「投資」深信不疑？有旅行社遭騙徒冒名開設戶口來騙取團費，負責人呼籲市民付款前務必核實資料。李家鼎、薛家燕等獲頒TVB長期服務獎，分享得獎喜悅。另送上可改善關節健康的資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#78[粵]
programme.desc: 龔喜聽保安穆季英介紹，買來附近「人氣」蛋糕店的榴槤蛋糕與嘉冰分享，意外引發風波……原來嘉冰早已推介該店蛋糕，龔喜卻聽而不聞；嘉驄道出嘉冰欠缺公信力的原因。網上流傳將有鼠疫等災禍發生，嘉冰大舉囤積物資，被嘉驄、祥劍取笑杞人憂天，只有龔喜、多勳支持她。嘉冰所住大廈竟有兇猛巨獸出沒，並造成破壞，導致斷水斷電。警方封鎖大廈，住戶留家保命，嘉冰一家物資充裕如常生活，隔壁的祥劍等因物資耗盡冒險出門求救……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#14[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 無雙疑惑綺雲不惜缺席生日會的原因，此時寶兒竟被爆料是雲生的私生女。其後，雲生偕寶兒召開記招……寶兒怪責德龍知而不告，德龍自責。無雙關心寶兒的同時，也對雲生之舉存疑，擔心寶兒無法遠離紛爭。丁丁查到線索，無雙藉電影《玫瑰》勘景之便，潛入療養院找到Cindy的母親，並破壞綺雲的跟蹤行動。無雙最終聯同菲雅順利與Cindy見面，菲雅意外知悉父親之死並不單純，於是拉着Cindy要前往警署報警，詎料……

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團[粵][PG] 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘[粵]
programme.desc: 一日玩足首爾十個景點？如風跟「鴨仔團」實測。從桂洞街往北村三景、韓屋村，沿途佈滿韓屋建築，如風瘋狂上斜縱感辛苦，仍樂於影靚相。經水泥風咖啡廳步至三清洞壁畫村，竟見激似C君的畫像？來到仁寺洞手作市集，如風搜獲戰利品，再試米田共造型冬甩。求籤扭蛋機夠特色，如風心急測戀愛運，竟砸中手指！一睹景福宮交接儀式後，往廣藏市場覓食，為蒜蓉包排隊半小時也值得？如風行到腳痛，其中昌德宮、東大門行程只得「到此一遊」。

programme.title: 武則天#35[粵/普]
programme.desc: 蕭薔縱火欲與媚娘、徐慧同歸於盡，徐慧捨身救媚娘而獲封賢妃。楊長史則挑起李牧仇恨，宮廷再醞釀逼宮危機。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條[粵] 及 環球新聞檔案[粵]
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞[粵]
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作[粵]
騙中傳奇#20[粵][PG]
programme.desc: (大結局)太和殿內，玉麟搬出另一真「順」神像，忠正出現，百般侮辱玉麟，玉麟無奈將牙人身份退讓。忠正謂真神像真金不怕烘爐火，但神像竟被燒毀，和珅才知被忠正出賣。假神像內之滿文透露大清禍胎乃是和珅，嘉慶將和珅斬首。原來當天寶兒獻身給和珅，取得玉麟的解藥，免忠正被威脅。寶兒決定重新做人，而顧井亦發覺自己愛上了九斤二。玉麟誕下雙胞胎，九斤二亦答允下嫁顧井。嘉慶賜封忠正「天下第一牙」，讓他們永享福祿。
